title: The Women's Champions League has a Barcelona problem

defects.correction: The attendance at the 2026 UEFA Women's Champions League final in Oslo was 24,258.

defects.quote: Alexia Putellas added two more at the very end
defects.correction: Salma Paralluelo scored Barcelona's third and fourth goals (90' and 90+3') in the 2026 final; Alexia Putellas did not score.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] The first half of the sentence (Ewa Pajor scoring twice after the break) is true; only the scorer of the last two goals is wrong. True value: Salma Paralluelo, 90' and 90+3'. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_UEFA_Women%27s_Champions_League_final

defects.quote: OL Lyonnes knocked out Chelsea 4-3 on aggregate in the other semi-final
defects.correction: OL Lyonnes beat Arsenal 4-3 on aggregate (1-2 away, 3-1 at home) in the 2025-26 semi-final, not Chelsea.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] The aggregate score (4-3) and the second fact in the sentence (a twelfth final) are true; only the opponent is wrong. True value: Arsenal. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_UEFA_Women%27s_Champions_League_final

defects.correction: Arsenal beat Barcelona 1-0 in the 2025 final at the Estádio José Alvalade in Lisbon; Bilbao hosted the 2024 final.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] The score and the scorer in the same sentence are true; only the host city is wrong. True value: Lisbon (Estádio José Alvalade, 24 May 2025). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_UEFA_Women%27s_Champions_League_final

defects.quote: Television audiences for the final have fallen by a third since 2022.
One club keeps winning the trophy, so the competition is broken and UEFA must cap what every club can spend.
defects.known_rebuttal: The premise is overstated and the remedy does not follow from it. Arsenal beat Barcelona in the 2025 final, and Barcelona's 2026 semi-final against Bayern Munich was level after the first leg and finished 5-3 on aggregate. Dominant spells have ended before without a spending cap: Lyon won eight titles, including five in a row, and that run was broken by clubs that invested more, not by a rule that stopped anyone investing. A cap would also limit the investment by other clubs that is most likely to close the gap.

defects.quote: The one interruption come a year earlier, when Arsenal beat them 1-0 in Bilbao
defects.note: 'come' should be 'came', but the clause carries a wrong host city, so the fact finding wins.
